 Follow Cardi B’s Toddler Son Goes on a Balloon Rampage at His 1st Birthday Party
 Dolly Bhamrick Thu, November 5, 2026 at 8:17 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Photo Credit: Arnold Jerocki/Getty Images for Vogue Cardi B 's son had his own plans for the decorations at his first birthday celebration. In the party clips shared online, the toddler heads straight for the balloons, turning the carefully arranged display into his personal play area. The celebration also gave fans a look at his birthday cake and the name Cardi had kept private until now.
 Cardi B's toddler son goes straight for the balloons and unleashes chaos at first birthday party
 Cardi B gave fans a glimpse of her youngest son's big day on Instagram Stories, and the little boy seemed more interested in playing with the decorations than in simply posing for pictures.
 Surrounded by green balloons and Mickey Mouse-themed displays, he reached for the balloons and happily explored the setup. His playful antics added an unscripted moment to the birthday celebration.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The party also featured a striking custom cake. The green, multi-tiered creation included Mickey Mouse details , character decorations, and large lettering spelling out "GREY" and "M.D." A smaller Mickey-themed cake was also displayed nearby, adding a playful, Disney-inspired touch to the celebration.
 The birthday festivities came with another special reveal. Cardi introduced her youngest child, Grey Marsean Diggs, in a heartfelt Instagram tribute on November 4, marking his first birthday. The rapper had welcomed him with NFL player Stefon Diggs in November 2025 but had largely kept his name and face private.
 "Happy 1st birthday to Grey Marsean Diggs," she wrote, reflecting on how much her son had meant to her during a difficult period. She also shared that carrying him gave her extra strength during one of the most uncertain times in her life.
 Grey is Cardi's fourth child and her first with Stefon. She also shares daughter Kulture, son Wave, and daughter Blossom with her estranged husband, Offset. While Cardi's birthday post offered an emotional introduction to Grey, the party videos showed a more playful side of the milestone.
